HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism? (1 mark)
   A. Use Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism.
   C. Say Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Basic chants/mantras as per Buddhism with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

   D. Apply the teaching of Managing Resources. 9 6.0. Yoga 6.1. Asanas 8 6.2. Communal Aspect of Yoga. 9 7. with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
